svg.title: spiral-ziggurat bore - section 12 of 13, bend UUUUURRRRRRRD~f, 8 parts on 570x149mm
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. 10mm square bore in 3mm stock, cut for a 3mm sheet at 0.15mm kerf, so a 16mm block pitch; a block that runs straight is 16mm long and a block that turns is a 16mm cube. Blocks 43-56 of the walk, entering on U and leaving on D, a 8x6 block plate laid flat. Two face plates (mirror images) and the side walls; every part carries the section number only. Inner cuts are the port and come before their outline. black #000000 cuts, blue #0000ff engraves.
